tail_semantics.native_behavior: in the final z-block (bidz=ceil(n_t/32)-1, local_n_t=n_t-bidz*32<32) the shared load visits columns 0..d_conv+30 for every one of the 128 rows; columns >= local_n_t+d_conv-1 map to token indices >= n_t+d_conv-1, i.e. (32-local_n_t) floats past each channel row end (into the following row, or past the checked span on the last row of the last sequence); all such values are unused by the dot products
tail_semantics.bounded_default: arg5!=1: those loads are skipped (col<cut=local_n_t+d_conv-1 guard); untouched smem slots are never read; outputs are bit-identical to native for all defined inputs and no access exceeds the checked span
tail_semantics.native_trace: arg5==1: loads replicate the native address trace including the padding reads; parent storage must guarantee at least (32-local_n_t) floats of slack after each channel row of the final z-block; for trace parity only
